== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Undercover (Dark) (Japanese)|Undercover (Dark)]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67769 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(50, 16, 430, 612)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>d81803cf3d9bf9afc1b8f97c9c637b57fbf8884922bce0da7a440625313299ca</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
